reconfigure.title: Change ETA Touch connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the same ETA controller. Its identity cannot be verified automatically. Existing entities and sensor settings are retained.

user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local ETA Touch REST API.

data_description.variables: Optional. One variable per line as Name=112/10021/0/0/12112. If empty, the ETA menu tree is discovered automatically.
